components.name: Hazard Symbol
components.description: Active flood (filled), ended wildfire (hollow), active Red earthquake (two severity rings).
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-symbols { display:flex; gap:1rem; align-items:center; background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Radio chips for the window and minimum severity; selected takes the accent border and tint.
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-chips { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:0.25rem; width:220px; background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem; } .ds-chip { position:relative; } .ds-chip input { position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; margin:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip span { display:block; padding:0.3rem 0; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); text-align:center; font-size:0.87rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover span { background:var(--raise); } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, var(--surface)); border-color:var(--accent); font-weight:650; } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: List Toggle
components.description: Opens the accessible events list; accent text, chevron turns when open.
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-list-toggle { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:228px; padding:0.45rem 0.6rem; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--raise); color:var(--accent); font:inherit; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:pointer; } .ds-list-toggle:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, var(--raise)); } .ds-list-toggle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-list-toggle svg { transition:transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-list-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] svg { transform:rotate(180deg); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Theme switch, close and sheet toggle; muted until hovered.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Close event"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.5 3.5l9 9M12.5 3.5l-9 9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-icon-button { display:grid; place-items:center; width:2rem; height:2rem; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius); background:none; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background:var(--raise); color:var(--text); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Map Style Select
components.description: Basemap chooser with a drawn chevron and the tile credit beneath.
components.html: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-field { width:228px; background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem; } .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:0.45rem; font-weight:650; font-size:0.87rem; } .ds-wrap { position:relative; } .ds-wrap svg { position:absolute; right:0.6rem; top:50%; translate:0 -50%; pointer-events:none; color:var(--muted); } .ds-select { appearance:none; width:100%; padding:0.4rem 2rem 0.4rem 0.5rem; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--raise); color:var(--text); font:inherit; font-size:0.93rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-credit { margin:0.35rem 0 0; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--muted); }

components.name: Panel Tabs
components.description: Details, News, Posts, Weather; selected takes text colour and a 2 px accent underline.
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:0.25rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); background:var(--surface); padding:0 1rem; } .ds-tabs [role='tab'] { padding:0.4rem 0.5rem; margin-bottom:-1px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; background:none; color:var(--muted); font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs [role='tab']:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-tabs [role='tab'][aria-selected='true'] { color:var(--text); font-weight:650; border-bottom-color:var(--accent); } .ds-tabs [role='tab']:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-count { margin-left:0.3rem; color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Event List Row
components.description: Symbol, title and a muted meta line; the selected event takes an 18% accent tint.
components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-list { list-style:none; margin:0; width:228px; background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem; } .ds-list button { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; column-gap:0.5rem; width:100%; padding:0.4rem 0.3rem; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius); background:none; color:var(--text); font:inherit; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-list svg { margin-top:0.15rem; } .ds-list button:hover { background:var(--raise); } .ds-list button[aria-current] { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, var(--surface)); } .ds-list button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-meta { grid-column:2; color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; }

components.css: :host { --ground:#0c0c0c; --surface:#171717; --raise:#212121; --rule:#2f2f2f; --text:#e8e8e8; --muted:#a8a8a8; --accent:#8ab4ff; --accent-ink:#0c1424; --alarm:#ff7a7a; --radius:6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text); } .ds-marks { display:grid; gap:0.5rem; justify-items:start; background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem; } .ds-marks p { margin:0; } .ds-stamp { padding:0.1rem 0.45rem; border:1.5px solid var(--alarm); border-radius:3px; color:var(--alarm); font-weight:650; font-size:0.8rem; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-badge { padding:0.1rem 0.5rem; border:1px solid var(--muted); border-radius:3px; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:650; }

narrative.overview:
A dark, quiet world map with every event drawn as a weather-chart symbol in its hazard colour. Shape and colour each tell the hazards apart on their own, so the map reads at a glance and still reads for someone who cannot tell two colours apart. Everything around the map is a plain, solid frame: a filter column on the left, an event panel on the right, hairline rules between them.

Dark is the default; a light theme swaps the same roles onto white surfaces over a warm grey map. The basemap can be chosen separately, and the map's symbols, clusters and selection ring follow the basemap's own ground (dark or light), not the page theme. Density is that of a tool, not a page: small type, tight rows, figures in fixed-width digits.

The frontend draws and never decides. Severity labels (hence the rings), staleness (the STALE stamp), country names and the hazard list all come from the API; the design only gives them a shape.
keyCharacteristics: Solid surfaces only; no shadows, glow, gradients or see-through panels.
Twelve hazard symbols: a disc in the hazard colour with a dark chart glyph; hollow when the event has ended.
One accent, for what can be pressed or is selected.
One red, for the STALE stamp and errors.
System sans throughout, fixed-width digits for counts, dates and temperatures.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks only what can be pressed or what is selected. It never decorates, never fills a panel, never colours a heading.

rules.name: The Ground Decides Rule
rules.body: A symbol takes the colour set of what it sits on: on the map, the basemap's ground; in the column and panel, the page theme. A new basemap declares its ground, and that is all it needs.

rules.name: The Measured Palette Rule
rules.body: A new hazard colour joins only if it meets the same floors as the rest (dark: 6:1 and 13.3 CIEDE2000 from every other colour, accent and selection ring included; light: 3.2:1 on #f2f3f0 and white, 10.5 from every other). If it cannot, the hazard uses Other.

rules.name: The Alarm Is Data Rule
rules.body: Red appears only when the API says something is wrong: the STALE stamp from the pipeline's stale flag, and error text. Severity is never shown in red; it is shown as rings.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a reader compares (counts, dates, data age, chips, facts, forecast, temperature) uses fixed-width digits.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Text is regular (400) or emphasised (650). There is no light weight and no third emphasis.

rules.name: The Solid Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Every panel, drawer, sheet, control and credit line is opaque. No shadows, no blur, no glow, no gradients.

dos: Do draw every event with its hazard symbol, filled when active and hollow when ended, with severity rings only from the API's Orange or Red label.
Do pick symbol, cluster and selection colours from the ground the symbol sits on: the basemap's ground on the map, the page theme elsewhere.
Do keep every text colour at WCAG AA or better in both themes; the built system's lowest is 5.08:1 (light) and 5.32:1 (dark), at desktop width and at 375 px.
Do keep the tile credit spelled out on a solid surface, and keep the map's bottom-right corner free.
Do use fixed-width digits for every count, date and measurement.
Do keep the frontend free of data logic: labels, staleness, country names and the hazard list arrive from the API and are shown as given.
donts: Don't use shadows, blur, glow, gradients or see-through panels.
Don't use the accent for anything that cannot be pressed or is not selected.
Don't show severity in red, or derive it from a score in the frontend; red belongs to the STALE stamp and errors.
Don't add a hazard colour that misses the measured floors, or a hazard symbol without a glyph of its own.
Don't use emoji or font glyphs as icons; draw them as inline SVG in the text colour.
